about: Live validation of the modelpin CLI on Gemini via Vertex AI, 2026-09-15/16. null = baseline and check on the SAME model, so any regression is a false alarm; migration = baseline on `from`, check on `to`. runs=5, confirmation on, judge a Gemini model that is neither side. `review` is an independent model's reading of every migration flag (see review_model per row).
